description: Power KPI is a versatile and highly customizable visual for Power BI, designed to display key performance indicators (KPIs) alongside contextual data and advanced formatting. It is ideal for dashboards that require both clarity and analytical depth. Key Capabilities KPI Display: Present KPI value, status symbol, and variance, along with title, subtitle, and current date. Symbol Customization: Choose from a wide range of indicator symbols including circles, triangles, squares, diamonds, flags, checkmarks, arrows, stars, and more. Apply custom colors to align with your data semantics or branding. Advanced Formatting: Customize font sizes, text and background colors, labels, and tooltips. Set alternate titles and descriptions for enhanced clarity. Flexible Layout Options: Toggle card values on or off and position them at the top, bottom, left, or right of the visual. Integrated Line Chart: Includes trend lines, forecast lines, and comparison lines. Supports hover tooltips, reference lines, axis customization, and legend placement. Threshold Control: Define KPI thresholds using either:A column in your data model with symbol index values A calculated column with auto-generated thresholds Responsive Design: Create detailed report tiles that automatically scale when pinned to dashboards. Maintain readability and visual integrity across different tile sizes without duplicating visuals.
